name: Pop foam furniture
summary: Seats, sofas and stands cast in soft polyurethane foam as one big object: lips, grass blades, a cactus. They are Pop art jokes that a person can sit on or hang a coat on.

philosophy.core_thesis: A soft foam can take any shape, so a piece of furniture can be a picture of an everyday thing at full size, and the joke is part of its use.
design_principles: Cast each body as one soft block of foam, so that the object is its own picture.
Choose one familiar subject for each piece: a mouth, a plant, a stone, a classical capital.
Draw the subject at a size larger than life, so that the body is also a seat or a stand.
Give each piece one colour on 90% of its surface, in a flat and strong tone.
Keep the surface smooth with no joint, no stitch line and no applied trim.
Make the foam give a little under the hand, so that the piece reads as soft before anyone touches it.
Show the piece alone on a plain floor, like a sculpture, with a long shadow.
anti_patterns: Hard shells with a sharp edge
Quiet geometric forms without a subject

form.geometry: A large single volume copied from a known thing, such as a pair of lips, a clump of grass or a cactus, with the seat or the arm cut into it.
form.silhouette: The outline of the subject itself, with no frame or leg: it sits on the floor as a mass or on a short stem.
form.edges: All edges are soft with a radius of 30 mm or more; the foam body has no hard corner.
form.proportion: A seat is 70 to 110 cm wide and 60 to 90 cm high; a coat stand is about 170 cm high; a blade of grass is 8 to 12 cm thick.
form.ornament: None applied. The shape of the subject and one flat colour are the whole surface.
rules: Each piece reads as one named subject from 3 m away.
Each exterior corner has a radius of 30 mm or more.
One colour covers 90% or more of the surface.
No visible frame, leg or fixing on the main body.
The subject is larger than life by a factor of 2 or more.

materials.rule: Foam makes 85% or more of each piece; a fabric or paint skin covers it, and any metal is a small hidden insert.

finish.gloss: 5–40 GU on the skin; the skin is flat or satin, never mirror-bright
finish.patina: The style wants a clean, bright skin; a dent that does not recover, a split or a faded colour is a fault.

hardware.section: Hidden inserts of 10–20 mm; no visible rods
hardware.joints: None visible. The body is one foam moulding; a hidden steel or wood core takes the weight where a stem is needed.
hardware.handles: None; the shape of the subject gives the grip.
hardware.switches_and_taps: A round or lip-shaped push plate in soft-touch plastic; no visible lever.

palette.strategy: One flat, strong colour for each piece, taken from the subject, on a plain pale floor.

processes: curing and release of the foam body
spraying or covering of the skin
manufacture.scale: An art-like multiple made in series by one furniture firm and sold as a limited edition at first, then kept in the catalogue for decades.
manufacture.signs: A faint parting line where the mould halves met, a soft give under pressure and a skin that is flat and even in colour.

objects.form: moulded bowl lamp on a stem
sofa cast as a pair of lips
moulded nature carpet of grass or stones

positive: sofa shaped like a pair of lips
seat made of giant grass blades
studio product photograph on a plain floor

canonical_works.maker: Giorgio Ceretti, Pietro Derossi and Riccardo Rosso

evidence.title: Bocca sofa by Studio 65, made by Gufram
Capitello chair by Studio 65, made by Gufram

emotion.target_response: Amused surprise: the viewer sees a giant everyday thing, laughs, and then wants to sit on it.

use_cases: a Pop art gallery or showroom moodboard
a still life for a design museum shop
a set for a 1970s Italian film
avoid_when: The room needs quiet, handmade and natural objects.
The brief asks for hard, glossy shells or chrome.

modifiers.how: Swap the foam body for a hard fibreglass shell on a chrome base, and raise the gloss to 90 GU.
Keep the soft body, but split the surface into laminate planes with loud patterns.
Replace the subject shape with a plain upholstered form on oak legs.

era_blend.note: A reissue keeps the subject and the foam; a new piece keeps only the one-colour soft body.
